name: Rafting Course & Internship
benefit: The beneficiary will receive training and internship opportunities to become a river rafting guide.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a youth of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be between 18 to 30 years of age. 1. The applicant must be educated. 1. The applicant must be mentally and physically healthy. > The total number of 215 beneficiaries will be selected.
